## Judgment

## Change
- pi-durable input moves from 4930005 to the lease retry commit. A team delivery that meets a repository lease held by another process (after a restart, the process that died) sleeps until the lease ends and tries again, instead of falling back or failing the task.

## Evidence
- Live restart of petunia at 22:31:13 during three team runs: every member that needed a new tree hit the dead process's lease; near and in fell back, out failed its worker tasks.
- Targeted checks: 337/337 team, worktree and workspace tests; the new test fails without the fix. check-style and check-docs pass. scripts/ci.sh was not run (the owner holds CI until it is wired to Gitea).

## Risk
- A delivery can wait up to 10 minutes for a lease before it falls back as before.
